d: Interior of a farmhouse. To the right towards the bottom of the door of a room. A rustic armrest chair, close. A bench, some chairs. The prospect is open, and from it you can see a picturesque site on the mountains of Savoy, and part of the village. A church on top. The dawn, the sun goes gradually illuminating the scene. You can hear the last touches of a bell. Various voices from opposite parts, which are heard: you can see then men, women, children going to the temple, then Maddalena, and then Antonio.
Several voices outside of Men and Children at the farm. Then they proceed and surround the Marquis, who will then be chased by The Intendant.
Linda with a bunch of flowers, then the choir of the Children, then Pierotto.
Linda, call the Viscount under the name Carlo.
The Prefect, and Antonio.
Linda with a sheet in her hand, and the Prefect.

From the heights of the village appear young Savoys, Savoyards, with their burden hanging from the back and the staff, among their relatives. Pierotto also with his own burden, and a wreath, Maddalena, Antonio with a burden and hat for Linda. The Prefect.

Elegant apartment of a house in Paris. To the right of the actor leads to the rooms. Left entrance door. At the bottom of a large window, from which you look on the street. Between the window and the secret door. On the same side a rich toilette: nearby chair, coffee tables, chairs, and luxury furniture, and fashion at that time. Linda sitting thoughtfully.
Pierotto with the hat in his hand, the wreath hanging behind his shoulders. He stops on the shy, uncertain door, looking at Linda, the room.
Linda, then the Marquis.
The Viscount, then Linda.
Linda, then Antonio.
Pierotto, and the record.
Linda and Pierotto.

A square in the village located in the middle of the valley. Rustic houses. Osteria with porch, under which tables, benches, chairs. A hill with various practicable paths. Further to the left of the actor the door of an internal house. Before rising the canvas I smelled from afar a prelude, and sound of gild, and voices of . ..Live!Savoiardi, Savoiarde, starts under the porch sitting at the tables, drinking, and eating. Others outside looking towards the bottom. On the hill meanwhile appear groups of young Savoiardi, and maidens with their saddlebags, and garlands. They stop for a moment, observing, and then making hints of exultation, and greeting, and sending kisses to those, waiting for them on the floor, coming down.
The Prefect and the Viscount.
The Marquis from the bottom of the hill, then Chorus.
Linda and Pierotto.
The Prefect, Linda, Pierotto.
The Viscount, then the Prefect; then the Choir, the Marquis, Antonio, and Maddalena.
Pierotto playing the wreath, all previous ones, then Linda.
